projects.title: Elder's Veil
projects.shortSummary: A comic and manga reading platform with immersive reading, user accounts, and content management.
projects.problem: Readers need a comfortable comic-reading experience without unnecessary interface clutter.
projects.solution: Developing a responsive comic platform with comic discovery, reading features, authentication, and administration tools.
features: Comic and manga browsing catalog
Responsive web comic reader
Email OTP registration and authentication
Creator submission and review workflow
Admin management dashboard
Exclusive premium membership controls
Progressive Web App support

projects.title: Beyond the Circuit
projects.shortSummary: Personal digital portfolio built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite featuring interactive circuit themes and dynamic JSON content.
projects.problem: Engineers working across both ECE hardware and web software need a cohesive digital identity that reflects both disciplines.
projects.solution: Architected a high-performance portfolio featuring live visitor statistics, circuit animations, and decoupled JSON content configuration.
features: Dual-identity hardware and software project showcase
Dynamic JSON-driven content architecture
Realtime visitor presence and interaction counters
Glassmorphism and custom circuit trace animations
Optimized WebP image pipeline with zero layout shift
Dark and light theme support

projects.title: Portfolio Manager
projects.shortSummary: A comprehensive investment tracking platform for Indian equities, mutual funds, ETFs, and F&O positions with SQLite persistence.
projects.problem: Tracking investments across stocks, mutual funds, and fixed assets manually leads to fragmented records and missing portfolio insights.
projects.solution: Built a private, modern financial dashboard featuring automated P&L metrics, capital gains reporting, XIRR calculations, and local SQLite database backups.
features: Total Net Worth, P&L, and XIRR annualized return tracking
NSE & BSE equity holdings management with custom buy price and brokerage logging
Mutual fund tracking with AMC, SIP, and lump sum recording
Portfolio analysis with broker and market-cap/sector allocation breakdowns
Report generation (Portfolio Summary, Capital Gains, Mutual Fund XIRR, CSV exports)
Light and dark mode themes with local SQLite backup and restore

projects.title: Kabbadi Pro
projects.shortSummary: A digital Kabaddi tournament management suite with team rosters, player tracking, automated fixtures, and point tables.
projects.problem: Tournament organizers face manual scoring delays, paper-based roster chaos, and complex fixture scheduling during competitive matches.
projects.solution: Developed a dedicated tournament web application enabling match scheduling, raider/defender points aggregation, coin toss results, and PDF/JSON exports.
features: Tournament setup with venue, organizer, and team registration
Player roster management with jersey numbers, weight class, and playing positions
Interactive points table with auto-calculated match standings and won/lost tallies
Fixture generation for multi-round tournaments with toss results
Raider, defender, and all-rounder performance analysis breakdowns
Tournament data export in both JSON and PDF formats

projects.title: Expense Tracker
projects.shortSummary: A web application for personal expense tracking with budget planning, savings goals, and interactive visual analytics.
projects.problem: Tracking daily expenses manually makes it difficult to understand spending patterns and stay within budget limits.
projects.solution: A browser-based application designed with income/expense/savings breakdowns, money flow charts, and customizable savings targets.
features: Real-time balance, total income, total expense, and net savings cards
Interactive budget planner with remaining budget alerts
Dynamic pie, donut, and money flow bar chart analytics
Categorized transaction ledger with add and delete capabilities
Savings goal progress tracker

projects.title: Nightwave — Music Player
projects.shortSummary: A retro-modern web audio player featuring a rotating vinyl turntable arm, waveform scrubber, and custom playlist queue.
projects.problem: Standard web music players often feel utilitarian and lack tactile, satisfying visual interaction.
projects.solution: A browser-based music experience inspired by vinyl turntables with neon green accents and smooth playback controls.
features: Vinyl turntable arm visualizer with playback state indication
Real-time track progress scrubber and volume sliders
Curated playlist queue with active track highlighting
Shuffle, repeat, and skip playback controls
Keyboard navigation and responsive mobile interface

projects.title: Engineering Converter
projects.shortSummary: A dedicated conversion utility for electronics engineering, computing number bases, and signal calculations.
projects.problem: Performing manual conversions between binary, hexadecimal, and analog frequency units is error-prone and time-consuming.
projects.solution: A clean multi-mode conversion engine covering radix conversions, RF signal units, and microcontroller memory addressing.
features: Number base radix conversions (Binary, Octal, Decimal, Hexadecimal, Two's complement)
ECE signal conversions (Frequency to wavelength, dBm to Watts, Impedance)
Computing storage conversions (Bits, Bytes, KB, MB, GB, Baud rates)
Floating point IEEE 754 reference
Responsive, clean formula documentation
